_comment: Template for mysql-check named profiles. Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.mysql-check\config.json and fill in real values. Each profile can be selected with -Profile <name>; CLI args override profile values. Passwords are stored in plaintext — see SKILL.md 'Security notes' for how to lock this file down. Profiles with an 'ssh' block go through an SSH tunnel — see SKILL.md 'SSH tunnel' section.

example_direct._comment: Direct connection, MySQL is reachable on the LAN.

example_ssh_tunnel._comment: MySQL is only reachable through a bastion. server/port describe the MySQL endpoint AS SEEN FROM the SSH host. Auth options for ssh: key (recommended), or password (requires plink/sshpass/Posh-SSH). If using plink, also add ssh.hostkey (SHA256 fingerprint) to skip the host-key prompt on first run.

example_ssh_password._comment: Alternative SSH auth method using password (requires plink.exe). Also shows hostkey fingerprint.
